summary: Recent graduate in Computer Engineering, building at the intersection of backend engineering and AI — with hands-on experience in REST API design (Java, Spring Boot) and end-to-end AI systems (RAG pipelines, LLM integration, MCP). During a 7-month internship, helped a school staff team adopt AI tools into their daily workflows — translating real operational problems into practical no-code and low-code solutions, and communicating technical ideas clearly to non-technical people. Strong at figuring out where AI actually fits a use case and getting others comfortable using it. Open to internship opportunities in backend or AI engineering.

projects.name: ReelMind — Semantic Instagram Personally Saved Reel Search
projects.description: Solving a real gap in Instagram’s UX: saved reels have no native search, and third-party applications are web based — built a Telegram bot instead, turning your phone’s chat interface into a zero-friction reel search assistant available wherever Instagram is. Indexes reels from Instagram URLs or bulk JSON export, downloads video via yt-dlp, uploads to Gemini File API for multimodal analysis, generates semantic summaries, embeds them with sentence-transformers, and stores them in ChromaDB as a full RAG pipeline over video content. API load is distributed across two Gemini models, and the application is containerized and deployed on AWS EC2 via Docker and Docker Compose with persistent ChromaDB storage on a separate EBS volume.

projects.name: Doc-IQ — Document Intelligence Assistant
projects.description: Built a full-stack RAG application where users upload .pdf/.txt documents and ask natural-language questions. The system retrieves the most semantically relevant chunks and returns cited, grounded answers via Google Gemini. Deployed on AWS EC2 with systemd managing automatic startup on reboot and an EBS gp3 volume mounted at /data for persistent ChromaDB storage. Exposed a FastAPI web server with a zero-dependency HTML/CSS/JS frontend and a FastMCP server for direct Claude Desktop integration.
